explanations.210:
Study key: False, as you specified.
Source disagreement: SUMMATIVE 3.pdf, page 13, question 146 highlights True for the same statement; your screenshot labels it question 39 and you supplied False. The wording does not specify what varies, so this is a disputed study key rather than an independently verified technical conclusion.
Concept: Wireless QoS prioritizes traffic such as voice and video; WMM is a common wireless QoS mechanism.
explanations.211: IEEE 802.11 is the family of standards for wireless LANs. IEEE 802.1Q covers VLAN tagging; 802.1D covers bridging and spanning tree.
explanations.212: In an ad-hoc wireless network, devices communicate directly with one another without an access point. Infrastructure mode uses an access point.
